subject: Founders Lift — request for promotional top-up + billing carveout
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@founderslift.org>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@founderslift.org
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — possible top-up for cohort B startups?

Hi Marcus,

Hope you had a great week. Quick one from the Founders Lift ops team: cohort B is seeing higher-than-expected usage in the first 10 days (we've attached a short usage export). Several teams already exceeded their onboarding credits and are blocked from scheduled demos.

Is there any elasticity in the promo package for cohort partners — specifically a one-time top-up (additional $2,500 in credits) for up to 8 teams? They'd remain under the standard free-tier terms but need the runway to finish MVP demos. Finance is asking for a billing carveout so the top-up doesn't consume future committed credits.

We're moving fast on the calendar and would love to close this today if you can confirm.

Thanks —
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
Founders Lift Accelerator
[Attachment: FoundersLift-usage-report.csv (csv)]
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@founderslift.org>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible top-up for cohort B startups?

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the usage export. Appreciate the urgency. Short answer: we can do a targeted top-up for up to 8 teams, but we'll need a narrow contract addendum to: 

- Ensure the $2,500 per-team promotional credit is one-time (non-recurring)
- Prevent the top-up from being counted against any future dedicated/committed credits
- Confirm acceptable usage window (suggest 60 days from issuance)

Ben — looping you and Laura in to confirm accounting and ops. If finance signs off, I can approve the exception from an account-management perspective.

If that works, Elena, I'll send a one-page addendum and a DocuSign link for your legal ops to countersign. Can you confirm the list of beneficiary team accounts (emails or HubSpot IDs) by EOD?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@founderslift.org>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T11:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible top-up for cohort B startups?

Elena / Marcus —

From an enablement and billing perspective we can make the credit issuance a promotional grant attached to specific account identifiers. A few operational notes: 

- We will issue promo credits as a separate ledger item (label: FL-CohortB-Topup-07-2028) so they do not offset committed credits tied to any future Dedicated purchase.
- Validity: 60 days (per Marcus suggestion).
- Redemption cap: $2,500 per team, up to 8 teams.
- We need a short purchase order or signed addendum that includes the beneficiary emails / HubSpot contact IDs and the billing carveout language (one paragraph).

Laura, can you confirm the invoice / ledger flow? Also note: discounts/promos like this are subject to a single internal credit review to ensure no overlap with existing sponsor allowances.

Next steps proposed: Marcus to send addendum, Elena to return beneficiary list, Laura to approve ledger flow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Enterprise Programs | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@founderslift.org>
Date: 2028-07-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible top-up for cohort B startups?

All,

Confirming finance ops can implement the ledger carveout. Required items from Founders Lift legal/ops before we issue credits: 

1) Signed addendum referencing deal id FL-2028-07-01-01 (one-page PDF)
2) Explicit beneficiary list (emails or HubSpot IDs)
3) Confirmation that these credits are non-refundable and non-transferable

Once we have the above, we will: 
- Create the promo ledger entry (FL-CohortB-Topup-07-2028)
- Send a fulfillment report within 48 hours of issuance (CSV)

Attachment: sample addendum template attached (we'll populate).

Laura Bennett
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FoundersLift-MAAP-addendum.pdf (pdf)]
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@founderslift.org>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — possible top-up for cohort B startups?
